Duergar

Original: https://shrouded-lands.fandom.com/wiki/Duergar

The dwarves native to the Tantalus Mountains are nothing like their northern Grey Mountain cousins. They call themselves duergar. They are hairless as lizards and their complexions share the hues and granulation of the stone in their tunnels. None have been known to have a sense of humor. This may have to do with the fact that all alcohol is poisonous to them, and that they make no music. The ring of pickaxes and hammers against stone fill their cold, unlit halls day and night.

They are obsessed with rubies. Some duergar seized the Dismal Mine (21.27) in the War of the Six-Fingered Hand to mine them. They hoard the rubies, rather than cutting them or using them for magic.
